# Build log

Newest first. One line per merge to `development`: date, what, link to the component page.

- 2026-10-20 — The owner's calls on step B: the 13 queued deeper checks cancelled (all were the InSAR role's people); Bonaventura's brief line team corrected to "small team" (approved, the ad's sentence kept as evidence; a brief line can now be corrected by hand: `RoleScopeClaim`'s natural key). Recordings refreshed for $0.18 (18 CV readings; a few notes, career and draft readings for the browser tests). The 45 live-file tests ran for the first time in weeks: their 8 failures were the test, not the platform (copies of one CV are rightly one person; assembled quotes are checked piece by piece; an image-only CV goes to a person), now replayed free on every run: 627 core tests pass, none skipped. The browser tests ran again: two had stale screens (the Mobility panel, the job's inbox button) and two real bugs surfaced and were fixed: an unknown person, role or brief page could show "Something went wrong" instead of Not found (a race between two requests), and every page was 3 px too wide on a 375 px phone (the search box could not shrink). All 31 pass, replay only. Step E's preview built from real data (local, not committed) — [golden eval](components/golden-eval.md), [role brief](components/role-brief.md)
